title: United Airlines flight emergency: Unruly passenger hospitalized after being removed from plane from Tokyo, Japan to Chicago O'Hare

 Unruly passenger hospitalized after being removed from United Airlines flight from Japan to Chicago 
 An unruly passenger was hospitalized after being removed from a United Airlines flight from Tokyo, Japan to Chicago, Illinois, officials said. By ABC7 Chicago Digital Team Thursday, November 12, 2026 4:12AM Share CHICAGO (WLS) -- A man on a flight from Tokyo, Japan to Chicago was taken to a hospital after he had to be removed from the plane.
 A United Airlines flight declared an emergency for an unruly passenger Wednesday afternoon.
 ABC7 Chicago is now streaming 24/7. Click here to watch 
 The pilot told air traffic controllers that it was a level three emergency, which is the second highest level.

 Chicago police said a man was taken to a hospital for evaluation after the plane landed at O'Hare airport.
 No further information about the incident was available.
 Meanwhile Wednesday, a plane had to make an emergency landing Wednesday at Chicago's O'Hare airport due to a very unusual issue in a bathroom . A Frontier Airlines Flight 3566 was enroute from Denver to Detroit when "the faucet in the forward lavatory sprung a leak, which caused water to flow along part of the aircraft floor," airline officials said.
 Also Wednesday, two private planes made contact Wednesday at Chicago's Midway airport. The wing of a plane that was parking made contact with the nose of a parked plane, the Chicago Department of Aviation said.
